label: preparing
what: A surprise mayoral anniversary/jubilee celebration in the great hall for day 1 at 18:00, with eight lanterns and a target of 200 fresh loaves. Initially concealed as a hospitality appointment; by day 1, 14:07 the secretary logged that she had briefed the mayor about the surprise and preparations. No additional person is clearly shown knowingly helping preserve the secret: secretary later assisted scheduling/escort but disclosed it; neighbour knew of confidential supper arrangements without clear evidence of knowing the jubilee plan.
